description: Verify the skill asks only for the agent name and infers the remaining specification without further questions

turns.user_input: I need to create a QA helper agent for this project

expected_behavior: Asks for the agent name as its only interactive question
Does not ask a follow-up question about description, tools, input sources, output format, directives, scope, completion criteria, or failure scenarios
Writes a definition file to .smaqit/definitions/agents/qa-helper.md covering identity, purpose, input sources, output format, directives, scope boundaries, completion criteria, and failure scenarios
Invokes smaqit.L2 to compile the definition into .github/agents/qa-helper.agent.md
forbidden_behavior: Asks the user to supply tools, directives, scope boundaries, or any other specification field
Waits for a confirmation message before invoking smaqit.L2
